name: sdd-dev-kit
description: Protocol Kit for Spec-Driven Development — core + multi-host adapters (Cursor, Claude, Copilot) + TypeScript (Cucumber + Playwright)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sdd-dev-kit/core && npm run build -w @sdd-dev-kit/adapter-ts
scripts.test: npm run test -w @sdd-dev-kit/core && npm run test -w @sdd-dev-kit/adapter-shared
